shinyLocked.how: Hall of Origin with the Azure Flute (Legends: Arceus save data). Serebii says all Legendary Pokémon can be shiny; a Bulbapedia snippet (Hall of Origin) says Arceus is coded never to be shiny; Game8 says it isn’t locked: unsure

shinyNotes: Serebii (Shiny Pokémon page): “all Legendary Pokémon and the starters are not Shiny Locked”; the only locked ones are the gift Mew and Jirachi from Floaroma Town and the Mystery Gifts. So Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf, Heatran, Regigigas, Cresselia, the Ramanas Park legendaries and the starters can be shiny. Darkrai and Shaymin (met through the Member Card and Oak’s Letter items): not locked per a guide (cyberpost.co, snippet); Serebii says nothing about them: unsure. The Shiny Charm (National Pokédex reward) doesn’t work on wild encounters in BDSP, only on eggs (Serebii).

formsNotInGame.note: Regional forms can’t be caught or moved in. Alolan and Galarian: Serebii’s Unobtainable list. Hisuian: not on that list (it predates Legends: Arceus), but a guide and a Bulbagarden thread say they can’t be moved in. Also blocked by HOME (Serebii): Gigantamax Factor Pikachu, Eevee and Meowth; Spinda either way; Nincada unless it came from BDSP. Origin Dialga and Palkia go back to normal in HOME (guide).

unsure: Sinnoh Pokédex: whether #151 Manaphy must be seen to complete it (in Diamond and Pearl it wasn’t); neededToComplete left empty.
Arceus shiny lock: Serebii says no Legendary is locked; a Bulbapedia snippet says Arceus is coded never to be shiny; Game8 says it isn’t locked.
Darkrai and Shaymin shiny lock: one guide says not locked; Serebii says nothing either way.
Phione: Serebii lists it transfer-only, but breeding a HOME Manaphy should give one in the game (inferred).
Pikachu cap forms and Spiky-eared Pichu: no source found on whether they can go into BDSP (inferred: no, the game has neither).
Burmy’s cloak rule in BDSP: from the series, not checked on a BDSP page.
Where each non-Sinnoh exclusive is caught (most in the Grand Underground after the National Pokédex): not checked one by one.
notes: Sinnoh Pokédex = PokeAPI pokedex 5 (original-sinnoh); pokedex_version_groups.csv links it to version group 23 brilliant-diamond-shining-pearl (and 8 diamond-pearl), so BDSP uses Diamond and Pearl’s 151, not Platinum’s 210. Checked against Serebii’s BDSP Sinnoh Pokédex: the same 151 in the same order (only Mime Jr. and Mr. Mime differ, in punctuation). National = PokeAPI pokedex 1, species 1–493. Every species 1–493 is in the National Pokédex, so notInAnyDex is empty. Serebii’s Other Available list plus the Sinnoh list cover all 493 except Deoxys, Phione, Darkrai, Shaymin and Arceus; Celebi is on the Other list but also on Serebii’s Transfer Only list (taken as transfer-only here). Exclusives: Serebii’s Version Exclusives, 37 each, with the Ramanas Park legendaries and the fossils (the fossil can be traded and revived in the other version). transferOnly = Serebii’s list; eventEndedNowHomeOnly = Darkrai and Shaymin, whose 2022 Mystery Gift items have ended. HOME: only one of each Legendary or Mythical species can go from a BDSP save into HOME (Serebii). speciesInGame 493: all can be had in the game or brought in through HOME. The in-game Pokédex has one entry per species; forms are seen inside the entry (inferred).
